description: This file declares the interface for a client writer type 'cw-out' used in libcurl for writing data to client callbacks. It defines external symbols, functions for pausing, unpausing, and finishing data streams, and includes necessary headers.

methods.name: Curl_cw_out_is_paused
methods.description: Checks if the 'cw-out' client write has paused data.

methods.name: Curl_cw_out_unpause
methods.description: Flushes any buffered data to the client, maintaining chunk collation.

methods.name: Curl_cw_out_done
methods.description: Marks the end-of-stream and flushes all data to the client.
